questions.question: Which type of computer uses the 8-bit code called EBCDIC?
questions.explanation: EBCDIC is an 8-bit code developed by IBM and used mainly on IBM mainframe computers; microcomputers use ASCII.

questions.question: In conditional asymptotic notation, "Θ(f(n)) if g(n)" indicates that the algorithm's complexity is both upper and lower bounded by f(n) when:

options.A: g(n) is a lower bound on f(n)
options.B: g(n) is an upper bound on f(n)

questions.explanation: Conditional notation Θ(f(n) | P(n)) means the bound holds for all sufficiently large n for which the condition P(n) is true (e.g. n is a power of 2). It is not about g(n) being a lower or upper bound.

questions.question: How is the width of the data bus typically measured in a microcomputer system?
questions.explanation: Data bus width is the number of bits transferred in parallel (e.g. 8, 16, 32 or 64 bits). MHz measures clock speed, not width.

questions.question: In the backtracking approach for the 8-Queens problem, once a feasible solution is found, the algorithm:

options.D: Rearranges the queens to optimize the solution

questions.explanation: The standard backtracking algorithm for 8-Queens records a solution and then backtracks to continue searching for all remaining solutions. It does not simply stop, and it prunes rather than iterating through all possibilities.

questions.question: Secondary memory is the long-term store for programs and data while main memory holds program and data currently in use. What kind of an organization is this?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Dividing storage into main memory and secondary memory is a physical organization of memory, based on the actual hardware devices. Logical organization concerns how programs view and address memory.

questions.question: Each ___ represents a particular colour.
questions.explanation: Each pixel value encodes a particular colour (or intensity) in a digital image. A frame is a whole image and a character is text.

questions.question: What do we use to extend the connectivity of the processor bus?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: The PCI bus is connected to the processor bus through a bridge and extends its connectivity to other devices. SCSI is a separate peripheral bus for disks and similar devices.

questions.question:
This is an Assertion and Reason type question. Select the most suitable option considering the Assertion and Reason.
Assertion (A): CSS is an attribute of the table tag and is used to style tables on a web page.
Reason (R): CSS is used to apply styles, such as fonts, colors, and spacing in an HTML document.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.explanation: CSS is a separate style sheet language, not an attribute of the table tag, so A is false. R is true: CSS applies fonts, colours and spacing to HTML documents.

questions.question: The minimum number of productions required to produce a language consisting of palindrome strings over Σ = {a, b} is
questions.explanation: The minimal grammar is S -> aSa | bSb | a | b | epsilon, i.e. 5 productions: two for wrapping, two for odd-length centres and one for even-length strings.

questions.question: What is the difference between a URL and a web address?

options.A: A URL is a Uniform Resource Locator, while a web address is a way to identify a website on the internet.
options.B: A URL is a software program, while a web address is a hardware device.
options.C: A URL is a physical object, while a web address is a logical object.

questions.explanation: A URL (Uniform Resource Locator) is the formal address of a resource, while 'web address' is the everyday term used to identify a website. Neither is a software program, hardware device or physical object.

questions.question: Which of the following determines the need for the circular queue?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In a linear array queue, freed front positions cannot be reused; a circular queue reuses them, avoiding memory wastage. FIFO is followed by every queue, so it is not the reason.

questions.question: DOS stands for
questions.explanation: DOS stands for Disk Operating System, e.g. MS-DOS.

questions.question: What is De Morgan's theorem used for in digital logic?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: De Morgan's theorem converts the complement of a product into a sum of complements (and vice versa), which is mainly used to simplify and transform Boolean expressions. It is not a method for binary addition.

questions.question: The algorithm used in the Game tree to make decisions of Win/Lose is ________________?
questions.explanation: Minimax evaluates a game tree by assuming the opponent plays optimally, maximising at the player's levels and minimising at the opponent's, to decide win/lose moves. BFS/DFS and greedy search do not model an adversary.

questions.question: In the context of recursion, what is the purpose of the "stack" data structure?

options.A: To store variables and function calls for backtracking

questions.explanation: Each recursive call pushes an activation record holding local variables, parameters and the return address onto the stack, which lets execution unwind (backtrack) correctly. It stores both, not only one of them.

questions.question: Which of the following is a pillar of OOP?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: The four pillars of OOP are encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance and polymorphism, so all three options are pillars.

questions.question: EBCDIC is mainly used in which type of computer systems?
questions.explanation: EBCDIC is IBM's 8-bit character code used mainly on IBM mainframes. Personal computers use ASCII/Unicode.

questions.question:
This is an Assertion and Reason type question. Select the most suitable option considering the Assertion and Reason.
Assertion (A): SMS is an acronym for Smart Message Service.
Reason (R): SMS is the most common technology for delivering short, concise and important messages quickly.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.explanation: SMS stands for Short Message Service, not Smart Message Service, so A is false. R is true because SMS is widely used for quick, short messages.

questions.question: A universal Turing machine is a ________
questions.explanation: A universal Turing machine takes the encoding of any other Turing machine and its input and simulates it, so it is a reprogrammable Turing machine. The number of tapes is not what makes it universal.

questions.concept: NAND and NOR as universal gates
questions.question: Digital circuit can be made by the repeated use of the _________.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Both NAND and NOR are universal gates, so any digital circuit can be built by repeated use of either one. AND alone is not functionally complete because it cannot produce inversion.

questions.question: Which SQL command is used to add new rows to a database table?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: INSERT INTO adds new rows to a table. CREATE defines new database objects such as tables, and ADD is used within ALTER TABLE to add columns.

questions.question: How can you make an asynchronous request to a server in JavaScript?

options.C: Using the fetch API or XMLHttpRequest

questions.explanation: The request itself is made with the fetch API or XMLHttpRequest. async/await and callbacks only help handle the asynchronous result; they do not send a request by themselves.

questions.question: What is the maximum data rate of Bluetooth version 5.0?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Bluetooth 5.0 (LE 2M PHY) supports a maximum data rate of 2 Mbps, double the 1 Mbps of Bluetooth 4.x LE.

questions.question: Delphi and COCOMO are techniques used for estimating:
questions.explanation: Both Delphi (expert consensus) and COCOMO (algorithmic) are used to estimate software development cost and effort. Size is an input to COCOMO, not what it estimates.

questions.question: Which function should be used to get first n rows of a dataframe?
questions.explanation: df.head(n) returns the first n rows of a pandas DataFrame (tail(n) returns the last n). print, get and call do not do this.
